mapper.select: SELECT fpa.BOARD,tpda.DEAL_MODE, tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.SETTLE_DATE, tpd.PS, tpd.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME, fp.CALENDAR_ID, tpd.TRADE_MARKET, tpd.TRADE_PLAT, tpd.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, tpd.INV_AIM, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.CCY, tpd.SHARE_AMT ,tpd.TRADE_AMT , tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.UNIT_INT, tpd.UNIT_FPRICE, tpd.CPRICE_AMT, tpd.INT_AMT, tpd.FPRICE_AMT, tpd.YIELD, tpd.EXER_YIELD, tpd.REMARK,tpda.lock_mdate,tpda.with_lock_period, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT,tpd.CHL_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptpd ON ptpd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa ON fp.FINPROD_ID = fpa.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON tpd.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID ENTRUST_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T6.TYPE_6 assetType1, T6.TYPE_7 assetType2, T1.CCY CCY, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T3.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, T3.FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_ABBR, T3.FINPROD_NAME FINPROD_NAME, T1.PS PS, T1.PRICE price, T1.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, T4.BOARD BOARD, T5.DEAL_MODE DEAL_MODE, T5.SEC_ACCT_ID SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T1.ENTRUST_AMT ENTRUST_AMT, T1.ENTRUST_NUM ENTRUST_NUM, T1.PRICE PRICE, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH, T1.ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH, T1.REMARK REMARK, T1.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, T1.COUNTER_TRADER COUNTER_TRADER, T1.CONTACT_INFO CONTACT_INFO, T2.TRADER TRADER, NVL(T7.FINISH_AMT,0) FINISH_AMT, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID INV_MANAGER_ID, T1.CHL_ID CHL_ID, T1.SALE_CODE SALE_CODE FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T5 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T5.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T6 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(NVL(FINISH_AMT,0)) FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T7 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T7.ENTRUST_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

select TRADEID code, TRADEID name from INTERF_TRAD_STOCKDEAL where not exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE INTERF_TRAD_STOCKDEAL.TRADEID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.F_TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatusInit} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag})
and TRADEID IN (#{initValue})
and TRADEID like concat(concat('%',#{param}),'%')

select TRADEID TRADEID, FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_MARKET_ID, SALE_CODE SALE_CODE, DEAL_MODE DEAL_MODE, PS PS, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, CCY CCY, TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE, SETTLE_DATE SETTLE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE UNIT_CPRICE, SHARE_AMT SHARE_AMT, TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT, FPRICE_AMT FPRICE_AMT, COMMISSION_AMT COMMISSION_AMT, STAMP_DUTY_AMT STAMP_DUTY_AMT, TRANSFER_FEES_AMT TRANSFER_FEES_AMT, CERTIFICATE_MANAGEMENT_FEE_AMT CERTIFICATE_MANAGEMENT_FEE_AMT, EXCHANGE_FEES_AMT EXCHANGE_FEES_AMT, RISK_AMT RISK_AMT, SETTLE_FREE_AMT SETTLE_FREE_AMT, FEE_AMT_1 FEE_AMT_1, FEE_AMT_2 FEE_AMT_2, FEE_AMT_3 FEE_AMT_3, SEAT_NO SEAT_NO, BROKERAGE_NO BROKERAGE_NO from INTERF_TRAD_STOCKDEAL where TRADEID = #{fedealno}
